title: Streaming & Digital Platforms
breadcrumb: Industries > Telecom, Media & Entertainment > Streaming & Digital Platforms
meta_description: Streaming platforms live on two curves: engagement (personalization, discovery, retention) and unit economics (encoding, delivery, churn).

blocks.x: Streaming & Digital Platforms: the operating units, priority programs and the five capability towers that matter most here.

The workflows we industrialize here: Personalization/discovery, Subscriber lifecycle, Delivery cost management, Experimentation, Anti-piracy. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Recommendations plateau without governance over objectives (engagement vs. Satisfaction).
View definitions, session metrics and retention measures inconsistent; product decisions wobble.
Cost per stream/hour by CDN/region/codec unknown; margin leaks.
Password sharing and stream-ripping drain ARPU; enforcement blunt.
Cancellation intents handled at save-desk; churn prediction un-wired to actions.
Experiment platform bottlenecks; product teams queue.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: Multi-objective recommendation with evaluation gates: satisfaction-weighted engagement
Certified engagement definitions with lineage: product decisions stable
Per-stream cost telemetry with codec/CDN policy: margin recovered
Sharing analytics with tiered enforcement: ARPU protected
Goal-directed agents that run inside your systems with defined roles, budgets and human checkpoints. Every action is logged, measurable and reversible.

blocks.x: We staff a named pod for this sub-industry pattern: delivery lead, quality owner and control owner, with the follow-the-sun rhythm covering build, run and the conformance monitoring that keeps the design honest after handover.

items: Churn down 19% in target segments: event-triggered save hub
